decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several types of backpacks including a lightweight daypack (ZOMAKE), tactical rucksacks (Seibertron and QT&QY), a hydration-specific pack (N NEVO RHINO), and a travel sling (MOSISO). I narrowed my search to larger, versatile packs that offer durability and organization. The QT&QY 45L Tactical Backpack (prod_backpacks_057) stood out because it has an impressive 4.7 rating across over 6,000 reviews, indicating high customer satisfaction and build quality for the price ($39.99). Compared to the Seibertron ($59.99) and the Mardingtop ($104.99), it offers better value for the capacity. While the ZOMAKE is much cheaper, it is designed for light use, whereas the QT&QY appears better suited for more rugged hiking or traveling needs.
